'''Cremator''' is a [[Keeper]] [[perk]] available in the [[Inspirations/Anatomy|Anatomy talent tree]].

== Prerequisites ==
*{{Mastery|Violet}} Anatomy mastery +1
*{{Item|Grave Builder}}

== Effects ==
Doubles the amount of materials obtained from cremating a corpse.<noinclude>
*{{Blueprint|Crematorium I|text=no}} [[Crematorium I]]
**{{Item|Ash}}: 10 (previously 5)
**{{Item|Salt}}: 2 (previously 1)
*{{Blueprint|Crematorium II|text=no}} [[Crematorium II]]
**{{Item|Ash}}: 14 (previously 7)
**{{Item|Salt}}: 4 (previously 2)</noinclude>
